paired_delta_definitions.recall/mrr/auroc/average_precision: candidate minus reference; positive is better
paired_delta_definitions.mean_rank_improvement: reference mean rank minus candidate mean rank; positive is better

tie_policy: conservative rank: every negative with score >= positive is ahead; curves aggregate equal-score edges

metric_definitions.macro_query_auroc: mean one-positive per-query AUROC; pair ties receive 0.5
metric_definitions.macro_query_historical_auprc: historical AUPRC label; exact AP alias
metric_definitions.micro_candidate_auroc: pooled over all N_E molecule edges
metric_definitions.micro_candidate_historical_auprc: historical AUPRC label; exact AP alias
